finalizeSyncSeparationPolicy: Finalize may run deterministic docs build on the blocking path and defer AI-capable enrich/text/translate work to warning or follow-up artifacts when changed files do not affect public docs surfaces.
differentialRunConditions: run AI docs when docs templates or directive text changed
run AI docs when public command help or README-visible behavior changed
skip or defer AI docs when only spec-local research artifacts changed
fallback to full docs build when docs review reports unresolved directives or stale generated text
